name: changelog-guard
description: Lint CHANGELOG.md files in Keep a Changelog format and enforce in CI that user-facing changes include changelog entries.
author: Yusuf Berat Zengin

scripts.demo: node bin/changelog-guard.js lint test/fixtures/invalid-date-changelog.md --format json | node scripts/make-demo.mjs
scripts.demo:check: node bin/changelog-guard.js lint test/fixtures/invalid-date-changelog.md --format json | node scripts/make-demo.mjs --check
